title: Enrich ACP turn-complete events before persistence and broadcast
answers: A reloaded agent thread loses the turn's trace ID
Where should missing ACP turn trace IDs be filled in?
How do stored and streamed turn-complete events stay consistent?
body:
Invariant: In products/desktop/packages/agent/src/adapters/acp-connection.ts:installWireTaps, apply trace enrichment before appendNotification and pass the same enriched message and event ID to onWireMessage.
Reason: Thread reloads read the stored notification; enriching only the broadcast copy leaves reloads without the trace ID needed to open the turn.
Guard: products/desktop/packages/agent/src/acp-extensions.ts:withTurnTraceId fills only turn-complete notifications with object params, a supplied fallback, and no existing string traceId.
Constraints: Preserve adapter-reported string trace IDs, leave other notification kinds unchanged, and supply no fallback when gateway headers did not stamp a trace.
applies: ACP wire notification enrichment shared by session logs and live agent event consumers.
